summary: Rewrote README.md (previously only the title line) with a concise usage guide for the static site: a short description of 'My Small Site', a Pages section listing index.html and about.html, and a Stylesheet section showing that each page links styles.css from its <head> via <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">, plus a note that the site needs no build step or server. Verified by re-reading README.md, confirming the referenced files (index.html, about.html, styles.css) exist in the repo root, and grepping both HTML pages to confirm line 6 of each contains exactly the documented stylesheet link. The repository contains no package.json, test files, or lint configuration, so no automated test suite is available to run. Only README.md was modified; no commit, push, or PR was performed.
